def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Извлекаем таблицы
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]
    
    # Приводим seed_time к datetime, если необходимо
    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    
    # Фильтруем заказы, которые были сделаны до seed_time
    orders_filtered = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time]
    
    # Объединяем order_items с отфильтрованными заказами
    df = order_items.merge(
        orders_filtered[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    
    # Оставляем только нужные product_id
    df = df[df["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]
    
    # Агрегируем payments по order_id, используя только данные до seed_time
    payments_agg = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time].groupby("order_id").agg(
        payment_sum=("payment_value", "sum"),
        payment_installments_mean=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        payment_count=("payment_sequential", "count")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Агрегируем отзывы по order_id, используя только данные до seed_time
    reviews_agg = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time].groupby("order_id").agg(
        review_score_mean=("review_score", "mean"),
        review_count=("review_id", "count")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Присоединяем агрегаты к df
    df = df.merge(payments_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    df = df.merge(reviews_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    
    # Вычисляем количество дней до seed_time
    df["days_before"] = (seed_time - df["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days
    
    # Функция для вычисления признаков за окно (в днях)
    def window_features(data, window_days):
        # Фильтруем по окну
        if window_days is None:
            mask = data["days_before"] >= 0
        else:
            mask = (data["days_before"] < window_days) & (data["days_before"] >= 0)
        sub = data[mask]
        if sub.empty:
            idx = pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id")
            return pd.DataFrame({
                f"count_{window_days}d": 0,
                f"sum_price_{window_days}d": 0,
                f"avg_price_{window_days}d": 0,
                f"sum_freight_{window_days}d": 0,
                f"avg_freight_{window_days}d": 0,
                f"sum_payment_{window_days}d": 0,
                f"avg_payment_{window_days}d": 0,
                f"avg_installments_{window_days}d": 0,
                f"avg_review_score_{window_days}d": 0,
                f"positive_review_ratio_{window_days}d": 0
            }, index=idx)
        grouped = sub.groupby("product_id").agg(
            count=("order_id", "nunique"),
            sum_price=("price", "sum"),
            avg_price=("price", "mean"),
            sum_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            sum_payment=("payment_sum", "sum"),
            avg_payment=("payment_sum", "mean"),
            avg_installments=("payment_installments_mean", "mean"),
            avg_review_score=("review_score_mean", "mean"),
            positive_review_ratio=("review_score_mean", lambda x: (x >= 4).mean() if len(x) > 0 else 0)
        ).reset_index()
        grouped.columns = ["product_id"] + [f"{col}_{window_days}d" for col in grouped.columns[1:]]
        return grouped.set_index("product_id")
    
    # Вычислим признаки для окон 7, 30, 90 и всех (None)
    windows = [7, 30, 90, None]
    frames = []
    for w in windows:
        fw = window_features(df, w)
        frames.append(fw)
    
    # Объединяем все окна
    features = pd.concat(frames, axis=1)
    
    # Вычислим тренд: сравнение двух последовательных 30-дневных периодов
    mask_current = (df["days_before"] < 30) & (df["days_before"] >= 0)
    mask_previous = (df["days_before"] >= 30) & (df["days_before"] < 60)
    
    current_period = df[mask_current]
    previous_period = df[mask_previous]
    
    if current_period.empty:
        count_current_30 = pd.Series(0, index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))
        sum_price_current_30 = pd.Series(0, index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))
    else:
        count_current_30 = current_period.groupby("product_id").size()
        sum_price_current_30 = current_period.groupby("product_id")["price"].sum()
        
    if previous_period.empty:
        count_previous_30 = pd.Series(0, index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))
        sum_price_previous_30 = pd.Series(0, index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))
    else:
        count_previous_30 = previous_period.groupby("product_id").size()
        sum_price_previous_30 = previous_period.groupby("product_id")["price"].sum()
    
    # Приводим к общему индексу
    count_current_30 = count_current_30.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)
    sum_price_current_30 = sum_price_current_30.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)
    count_previous_30 = count_previous_30.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)
    sum_price_previous_30 = sum_price_previous_30.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)
    
    # Добавим тренд в features
    features["count_trend_30d"] = (count_current_30 - count_previous_30).values
    features["sum_price_trend_30d"] = (sum_price_current_30 - sum_price_previous_30).values
    
    # Вычислим возраст и давность последней продажи
    first_sale = df.groupby("product_id")["order_purchase_timestamp"].min()
    last_sale = df.groupby("product_id")["order_purchase_timestamp"].max()
    age_days = (seed_time - first_sale).dt.days
    recency_days = (seed_time - last_sale).dt.days
    age_days = age_days.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)
    recency_days = recency_days.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)
    features["age_days"] = age_days
    features["recency_days"] = recency_days
    
    # Переименовываем колонки с "None" на "all"
    features.columns = [col.replace("None", "all") for col in features.columns]
    
    # Заполним NaN нулями
    features = features.fillna(0)
    
    # Реиндексируем по entity_ids
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    
    return features
